first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Replay ten merged Java changes at their APIs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Register the thirty M01–M10 predictions and falsifiers as examples 443–452. Use the pin-built artifacts, all four prepared JDKs and the same caller bytecode on each side. The public observations confirmed ten intent changes and ten controls. Three merged challenges exposed the Commons Compress writer preamble offset, Agrona entry hashes and libGDX reused bounds. The Jackson builds share the explicitly reconstructed snapshot inputs.

All ten normal example validators repeated the sixty public JVM histories, including the real Checkstyle CLI and both JDK 8 examples. All 55 selected test suites passed. The two earlier campaign audits retained their totals. Wrong providers, reversed artifact hashes, changed verdicts and an omitted trial were rejected. Job 20261125-220316-replay-all-30-m01-m10-public-predictions repeats the full campaign in an independent export and compares its audit byte for byte.

commits.summary: Cross-check M01–M10 on released libraries (verification pending)
commits.body:
Repeat the three historical counterexamples on six published versions. All eighteen histories used byte-identical historical caller classes compiled against public Maven artifacts. Commons Compress 1.28.0 still loses the writer preamble and Agrona 2.7.2 still misses two equal map entries in a HashSet. libGDX 1.14.2 returns the correct bounds after upstream repair 7522. Record the two filing decisions and the resolved historical case.

Register the original JVM methods for nine changes. The qualification checker now carries the exact resource bytes into every trial and verifies them in saved reports. Four original ZIP32 method-entry trials reproduced on the landed fixture. Altered fixture or caller digests were rejected. The independent 60-JVM campaign replay passed with byte-identical audit data, the 18 release observations repeated from a cache of public JARs alone, the three example validators passed, and all 35 selected suites passed.

Jobs 20261125-221210-trace-bitmap-containment-jackson-alias-r, 20261125-221210-trace-zip-offset-adjustment-rng-restore and 20261125-221210-trace-geojson-writing-polygon-clipping-a independently check 108 original-method trials. Job 20261125-221211-repeat-three-historical-witnesses-on-six repeats all six published deployments.

commits.summary: Record all five completed M01–M10 verification jobs
commits.body:
The full 60-JVM audit, six-release replay, and three original-method jobs all passed. Rechecked each of the nine collected debugger reports against the registered physical returns, fixture bytes, caller classes and invocation sites. They contain 108 qualifying trials. The separate Checkstyle CLI evidence and the two reports awaiting the user's filing decision are linked from the campaign results.

Compared the independent matrix audit byte for byte, checked all results-page links, and confirmed that the documentation-only change selects no additional test suites.
